title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
description:
# Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array

Given an array `nums` of `n` integers where `nums[i]` is in the range `[1, n]`, return *an array of all the integers in the range* `[1, n]` *that do not appear in* `nums`.

## Example 1:

**Input:** nums = [4,3,2,7,8,2,3,1]
**Output:** [5,6]

## Example 2:

**Input:** nums = [1,1]
**Output:** [2]

## Constraints:

*   `n == nums.length`
*   `1 <= n <= 10^5`
*   `1 <= nums[i] <= n`

solutions.name: Mark as Negative (In-place)
solutions.description:
## Approach

For each number, mark the position (num-1) as negative to indicate presence. Then collect positions that remain positive.

## Complexity Analysis
- Time Complexity: O(n)
- Space Complexity: O(1) excluding output

solutions.name: Cyclic Sort
solutions.description:
## Approach

Place each number at its correct position (nums[i] at index nums[i]-1). Then find positions where nums[i] != i+1.

## Complexity Analysis
- Time Complexity: O(n)
- Space Complexity: O(1) excluding output

solutions.name: HashSet
solutions.description:
## Approach

Add all numbers to a HashSet. Check which numbers from 1 to n are missing.

## Complexity Analysis
- Time Complexity: O(n)
- Space Complexity: O(n)
